verdict.rationale: ChatGPT documents in-product analysis of the user's own data: it can read files, analyze data, and summarize findings, and it can 'analyze files' and turn analysis into reports, spreadsheets, and interactive visualizations. Plugins (Google Drive, SharePoint, Salesforce, Gong, Slack) and local project folders bring user data into that analysis, and community comments praise file interpretation and retrieval over documents, though one notes answers can be plausible but wrong and weak with numbers. missing for 10: documented proactive (unprompted) insight or suggestion surfacing, in-depth first-party documentation of the data-analysis workflow, independent hands-on corroboration of analysis quality.
